decision: Demand survives lawful direct A→B materialization; DMA indispensability and translation bottleneck do not follow.

controls.name: No-copy/in-place host pointer forwarding
controls.operation: Publish B used entry without writing its original RX mbuf, handing off A/host pointer instead
controls.verdict: Does not satisfy unchanged B descriptor/cookie contract: guest reads its original B memory. This is a correctness counterexample, not a timing result.
controls.costs: If a changed guest/storage API makes it legal, allow that API and account adaptation; do not force copy.

controls.name: Direct NIC RX into guest buffers
controls.operation: When producer NIC and queue steering can target preposted B buffers, bypass host staging
controls.verdict: Retained legal alternative for external-ingress branch; selected VM2VM source starts in A guest memory, so NIC direct-RX cannot remove A→B transfer. Hardware VM2VM forwarding remains an ordinary native option with all NIC/network costs.
controls.costs: Descriptor provisioning, pin/map, alignment, hardware capability, guest buffer availability, NIC operation and completion.

controls.name: CPU direct A→B
controls.operation: After reading A TX descriptor and choosing B destination, copy complete spans once; build header, release-publish used after stores, return A completion after no further reads; B consumes and releases its own buffer.
controls.verdict: Fully legal strongest no-DMA baseline, including arbitrary tails and multi-span packets. CPU ability does not reject necessary movement.
controls.costs: Only CPU path actual preparation, accesses, metadata, barriers, consumer, release. Do not charge DMA-only global quiet/cache ownership or IOMMU controls to CPU.

controls.name: Direct one-DMA for same backend owner
controls.operation: Map both A/B regions in same legal backend domain, issue exact A→B spans, retire all segments, complete quiet/cache handoff, then publish B used and A TX completion. Share one channel across reciprocal flows.
controls.verdict: Fully allowed ordinary source-informed construction, not claimed already implemented in DPDK. Source staging copies and extra channels are not mandatory.
controls.costs: Longer retention of A until direct delivery, joint descriptor bookkeeping, all setup/MMIO/DONE/quiet/cache/consumer/drain cost.

controls.name: Multiple DMA channels
controls.operation: Assign flows to available existing iDMA engines while buffers remain CPU-inaccessible for a finite phase
controls.verdict: Ordinary multi-engine comparison only; do not force four channels or claim simultaneous natural traffic was observed.
controls.costs: Same fixed useful frames and real source-ready observations, total allocations and full phase/consumer completion.

controls.name: Shared backing/page loan/remapping
controls.operation: Transfer or alias an exclusive source page into B instead of copying
controls.verdict: Allowed if supported by actual buffer contracts. Must preserve B advertised guest address and cookie, source behavior after completion, all neighbor bytes and page ownership. Packed mbufs/subpage offsets and nonexclusive pages may preclude whole-page swap without copying neighbors; separate owner names alone do not preclude it.
controls.costs: Actual remap granularity, exclusivity/pinning/hugepage splitting, TLB invalidations, source replacement, neighbor preservation, delayed release and required guest/backend changes; capability and benefit unknown.

controls.name: Producer-direct placement
controls.operation: Change producer destination so A generates bytes directly into B buffer
controls.verdict: Use if source API/lifetime permits; would remove selected necessary-copy condition. Fixed guest TX/RX descriptor contract does not itself provide this permission.
controls.costs: Changed producer/guest storage interface, early route and destination availability, cancellation/backpressure.

controls.name: Hugepages/pre-map/residency/stable pool
controls.operation: Keep legal mappings and backing resident, choose supported large pages and allocate compatible pools
controls.verdict: Fully allowed. Source itself preallocates/locks async guest memory and recommends large guest pages. Do not flush translations between retained-map packets to create coldness.
controls.costs: Allocation failures, reserved memory, actual page-table count/leaf sizes, initial mapping, final unmap and invalidation.

controls.name: Batch/coalesce/layout/stable scratch
controls.operation: Batch known-ready descriptors, coalesce adjacent spans only when address/lifetime/ordering permit, use stable host or direct destination pools
controls.verdict: Fully allowed with full useful bytes and finite capacity. Avoid gratuitous host staging; do not prohibit source field reuse after legitimate consumption.
controls.costs: Waiting/retention, metadata, reservations, CPU supply, actual padding only if legal; no invented deadlines.

whole_task_fairness: Same externally received frames, identities/order and legal drops. Compare finish after consumer and release, not just DMA throughput. Unknown timings stay null.
not_claimed: new DMA method beats ordinary direct copy
distinct guest owners prove physical IOMMU isolation
